rows.text: “Cadence delivered excellent results for the second quarter of 2026, with broad-based strength driving double-digit growth across all our businesses,” said John Wall, senior vice president and chief financial officer. “With a record backlog and continued business momentum, we are now raising our 2026 outlook to 19% revenue growth, non-GAAP operating margin to 44.25%, non-GAAP EPS to $8.10, and operating cash flow to $2 billion at the midpoint.”
